findings.summary: A household could supply another resident_actor.
findings.repair: Residents cannot attach a report to another household. Staff must have maintenance.coordinate and a visible household membership.

findings.summary: Idempotency keys were shared across the organization.
findings.repair: Command keys are scoped to the acting user, and the resident form uses a random key.

findings.summary: A resident could store an internal note.
findings.repair: A household note is stored as resident-visible, and the insert policy rejects an internal note from a household.
